lead: Your morning-after reset, in a mango-orange strip. Seven liver-loving botanicals — turmeric, andrographis, amla and more — to support mental clarity, normal hydration and that 'back to yourself' feeling after a big night. No water, no pills.
note: 30 oral strips · Mango & Orange · ships in 1–2 days

science.title: Botanicals that help you bounce back
science.text: A big night taxes your liver, your hydration and your head. We packed seven traditional recovery botanicals — turmeric and amla for antioxidant support, andrographis and chanca piedra long used for the liver, plus date palm and grape seed — into a mango-orange strip that dissolves on your tongue, so support kicks in fast without water or pills.

format.title: Recovery that fits in your pocket
format.text: No fizzy tablets, no glass of water, no fuss. One mango-orange oral strip dissolves on your tongue in seconds — take it before bed or the morning after, anywhere you are.
list: — 1 strip = 7 botanical extracts in a fast-dissolving strip

absorb.title: Seven botanicals, one fast strip
absorb.lead: A dissolving strip is absorbed quickly under the tongue — so the botanicals go to work faster than a capsule that has to break down first.

points.title: Liver-support botanicals
points.text: Andrographis, chanca piedra and chicory — traditionally used to support the liver as it processes a night out.

points.title: Antioxidant boost
points.text: Turmeric, amla and grape seed deliver antioxidants to help with everyday oxidative stress.

points.title: Sublingual strip
points.text: Dissolves on the tongue for quick uptake — take it before bed or the morning after, no water needed.

ingredients.title: Seven recovery botanicals
ingredients.lead: Liver-support and antioxidant botanicals in a fast-dissolving strip.*

items.name: Turmeric
items.text: Curcumin supports a healthy inflammatory response and antioxidant defence as your body recovers.

items.name: Andrographis
items.text: Known as the 'king of bitters' — long used in traditional medicine to support the liver.

items.name: Amla
items.text: Indian gooseberry — one of nature's richest sources of vitamin C and antioxidants.

items.name: Date Palm + Grape Seed
items.text: Date palm and grape-seed extracts add polyphenols traditionally used to ease the morning after.

facts.side_title: A clean strip that dissolves on your tongue
facts.side_text: Seven botanical extracts — date palm, turmeric, andrographis, chicory, grape seed, chanca piedra and amla — in a vegan pullulan strip, flavoured with mango and orange and sweetened with stevia. Made in the USA — 30 strips.
facts.warning: For occasional use — not a substitute for moderation. Pregnant or nursing women, children under 18, and anyone on medication or with a medical condition should consult a physician before use.

steps.text: After a night out, place one strip on your tongue before you sleep and let it dissolve.

steps.title: Or the morning after
steps.text: Feeling rough? Take one when you wake up to support clarity and recovery.

steps.title: Stay hydrated too
steps.text: Strips support normal hydration — pair with plenty of water for the best reset.

items.a: Place one strip on your tongue and let it dissolve — before bed after a night out, or the morning after. No water needed.
No supplement cures a hangover — nothing replaces moderation, food and water. These strips use botanicals to support clarity, hydration and recovery so you feel more like yourself.

items.a: Before bed is ideal so the botanicals work overnight, but the morning after works too. Stay hydrated alongside it.
